{{Quote|The Gulch is the nickname we gave to an immense cavern inside the largest, most heavily carved asteroid in sector 867-3A4.|Korren Starchaser's datafiles|<ref name="SD" />}}
The largest '''asteroid''' of [[grid sector 867-3A4]] in the [[Serianan Belt]] of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]] [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]] contained the artificial [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] known as [[the Gulch]]. In its interior were stored five [[Serianan statue|alien statues]] that the crew of the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|New Republic Scout Service]] [[Scout ship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Jedi Dreamer]]'' discovered at some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Trace samples sent back to New Republic scientists have shown the minerals in this vicinity to be extremely dense and resistant to wear; however, preliminary evidence also indicates that the entire Gulch was hollowed out of this material.|Korren Starchaser's datafiles|<ref name="SD" />}}
An [[Atmosphere/Legends|airless]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] was the largest of such objects in [[grid sector 867-3A4]], an area of the [[Serianan Belt]] in<ref name="SD" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space's]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Serianan system/Legends|Serianan system]]. The portion of the asteroid out of which the artificial [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] that the team of [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services|New Republic Scout Service]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Korren Starchaser]] nicknamed "[[the Gulch]]" was hollowed was composed of unusual [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] that were extremely dense and wear-resistant.<ref name="SD" />

==History==
{{Quote|According to preliminary reports, however, the asteroids themselves are not likely a natural phenomenon, and may be the remains of a multiple planet collision.|Korren Starchaser's datafiles|<ref name="SD" />}}
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]] ''[[Jedi Dreamer]]'' under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of Captain Korren Starchaser undertook an [[Serias expedition|expedition]] to the Serianan [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Based on preliminary [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] reports, the [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] theorized that the asteroids of the Serianan Belt were the remains of a rare multiple-[[Planet/Legends|planet]] collision. On the largest asteroid of the [[Asteroid field/Legends|belt's]] grid sector 867-3A4, the ''Jedi Dreamer'' eventually discovered the cavern that was named "the Gulch." Using [[Vagabond suit|Vagabond]] [[Environment suit/Legends|deep space powersuits]], the scouts explored the cave, recovering five [[Serianan statue|alien statues]] from it that were hypothesized to form a part of a six-piece set.<ref name="SD" />

{{RPGseed}}
Eventually, Starchaser, wishing to protect the Serianan system from an ill-[[Time/Legends|timed]] discovery by "unsavory" interests, cut the expedition short. Later, however, the New Republic Scout Service hired a group of individuals to carry out a follow-up investigation of the Serianan Belt, primarily focusing on studying the mineral composition of the Gulch.<ref name="SD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Locations==
{{Quote|Large enough to carefully maneuver a small scout ship inside, the Gulch contained not only more designs on its interior, but also a stone alcove in the rear of the cave in which rested several small, perfectly preserved alien statues.|Korren Starchaser's datafiles|<ref name="SD" />}}
Of the asteroids of grid sector 867-3A4, the one containing the Gulch featured the highest concentration of the patterns of [[Serianan runes|ancient runes]] that were carved on the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] bodies. The Gulch itself was an artificial cavern that was spacious enough to allow for a small scout [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to carefully enter it. The cavern featured more of the runes on its interior walls, and its deepest part also had a [[Stone/Legends|stone]] alcove in which five alien statues were found. The statues were made of a similar type of mineral as the rest of the Gulch, with the material being dull [[Color/Legends|orange]] and completely opaque to standard scanning methods but also much less dense.<ref name="SD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The asteroid was introduced in the "[[Scouts' Dispatch]]" feature of the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|eighth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine, published in [[November]] [[1995]]. The feature was written by [[Peter Woodworth]] and included a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure seed related to the Gulch that this article assumes plays out as described.<ref name="SD" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Serias system, and therefore the asteroid, in grid square P-2.<ref name="TEA" />
